repos.description: 38 editorial diagram types for Claude Code, Codex, and Pi. Self-contained HTML + SVG. No shadows. No Mermaid slop.
repos.hook: This repository provides 38 diagram templates made with plain HTML and SVG. SVG means Scalable Vector Graphics, which are images that stay sharp at any size. You can paste these templates into AI coding assistants to generate clean visual diagrams.
repos.personalization: Useful when prompting AI coding tools like Claude Code to render architecture diagrams for your fullstack web apps.

repos.description: Self-evolving Context Database for AI Agents. Unify Agent Memory, Knowledge RAG and Skills.
repos.hook: OpenViking is a context database built for AI agents. An AI agent is a software program that performs tasks autonomously. The tool combines long-term memory, document search, and agent skills into one unified system.
repos.personalization: Helpful for testing how structured context storage improves prompt performance and consistency in agentic workflows.

repos.hook: Omarchy is an opinionated Linux operating system setup created by Basecamp. It installs a complete developer desktop with custom styles, standard tools, and streamlined default settings.

repos.description: 14MB foundation model for tiny devices; phones, wearables, smart home, and robots.
repos.hook: Needle is a tiny artificial intelligence model that requires only 14 megabytes of storage. It runs directly on small edge hardware like phones and home devices without an internet connection.
repos.personalization: Worth watching if you build privacy-focused mobile side projects that need on-device AI without monthly cloud API bills.

repos.description: Graph-Native Infrastructure for Context and Accountable AI Systems
repos.hook: Semantica is an infrastructure library that organizes data into knowledge graphs. A knowledge graph is a network of connected facts and relationships. This graph structure helps developers build AI systems that provide verifiable citations for their outputs.
repos.personalization: Relevant if you build auditable AI side projects, such as rule-checking workflows for Islamic finance compliance.

repos.description: Switchyard lets LLM applications route traffic across models and providers while preserving native OpenAI and Anthropic API compatibility - enabling flexible model selection, benchmarking, and cost/performance optimization.
repos.hook: Switchyard routes application traffic across different model providers through one central proxy. It maintains compatibility with standard OpenAI and Anthropic API endpoints. You can benchmark latency, compare answer quality, and optimize token costs without changing your application code.
repos.personalization: Directly supports your prompt evaluation workflows by letting you switch and benchmark different model backends side by side.

repos.hook: This repository hosts the Modular platform, including the Mojo programming language. Mojo gives developers the fast execution speed of C++ while keeping the simple syntax of Python.

repos.description: 利用 AI 大模型和自动化工作流，根据主题或关键词一键生成高清短视频。Generate HD short videos from a topic or keyword with an automated AI workflow.
repos.hook: MoneyPrinterTurbo creates short videos automatically from a single text topic. It writes the video script, generates voice narration, selects video clips, and renders subtitles.

repos.description: A collective list of free APIs
repos.hook: This project maintains a categorized list of free application programming interfaces, or APIs. An API is an interface that lets your code fetch data from external services.
repos.personalization: A handy directory to discover free endpoints (such as currency rates or prayer data) for fullstack side projects.

repos.description: holehe allows you to check if the mail is used on different sites like twitter, instagram and will retrieve information on sites with the forgotten password function.
repos.hook: Holehe checks if a specific email address is registered on more than 120 websites. It inspects password recovery pages without sending actual password reset messages to the user.

repos.description: ⚡️A native, local-first alternative to Logitech Options+, written in Rust 🦀 — remap buttons, DPI, and SmartShift over HID++. No account, no telemetry.
repos.hook: OpenLogi is a lightweight configuration tool for Logitech computer mice and keyboards. It runs entirely on your local machine with no user accounts and no background telemetry.

repos.description: Desktop app to generate 3D models from images or prompt using local AI — runs entirely on your GPU
repos.hook: Modly is a desktop program that generates three-dimensional models from images or text prompts. It executes all generative AI calculations locally on your computer graphics card.

repos.description: Macro is a unified workspace for teams: email, chat, docs, tasks, agents, calls, and CRM — @-linked together with shared AI memory.
repos.hook: Macro is an all-in-one workspace that brings email, team chat, documents, and tasks together. It connects these work items using a shared memory layer for AI assistants.

repos.description: Local UI to run and train LLMs and diffusion models, including Qwen3.8, Kimi K3, MiniMax-H3, Gemma 4, DeepSeek-V4, FLUX and more.
repos.hook: Unsloth allows you to train and run open-source large language models locally. It uses custom GPU kernels to make model training faster while consuming significantly less memory.
repos.personalization: Helpful to keep in your toolkit when prompt engineering alone reaches its limits and you need local model fine-tuning.

repos.description: Solution for long term memory for agent coding CLIs and to facilitate handoff between different agent vendors
repos.hook: This tool manages persistent, long-term memory for command-line AI coding assistants. It saves project context across sessions so you can hand off tasks between different AI tools without losing project history.
repos.personalization: Directly solves the context-loss problem when evaluating and switching between different AI coding CLI tools on your projects.

repos.description: LLM inference server with continuous batching & SSD caching for Apple Silicon — managed from the macOS menu bar
repos.hook: Omlx is an inference server designed for Apple Silicon Mac computers. An inference server runs language models and answers incoming text requests. You can monitor and control the server directly from the macOS menu bar.
repos.personalization: A convenient tool if you want to run fast local models on your Mac to test prompt ideas offline.

repos.description: Hundreds of models & providers. One command to find what runs on your hardware.
repos.hook: LLMfit is a command-line tool that inspects your computer hardware. It analyzes your processor and memory to show you which open-source AI models can run smoothly on your machine.
repos.personalization: Saves you setup time by identifying which local LLMs your development machine can comfortably run for prompt testing.

repos.hook: Freebuff is an open-source coding agent that works in your terminal. It inspects your project files, writes code changes, and runs commands to complete programming tasks.
repos.personalization: Another practical coding agent to benchmark against your current AI development stack.
